subject: literacy
concept: Reading a passage containing multiple multisyllabic and morphologically complex words, using word-part strategies
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while reading a passage containing complex words
exercise.abstract: Student reads a passage with multiple morphologically complex words aloud and defines at least two of them using word-part knowledge

assessment.mastery_threshold: reads with 90%+ accuracy and correctly defines at least 2 complex words using their parts
misconception_flags: decodes complex words accurately but cannot explain their meaning using known parts

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
